title: A candidate that must earn its place
subtitle: BUB1B-MVA · arimoclomol · functional rescue
label: 01 / THE QUESTION
narration: For a child with mosaic variegated aneuploidy, a plausible medicine is only a starting point. We propose arimoclomol for laboratory testing, with explicit rules for deciding whether it deserves to advance. We have not demonstrated drug rescue or treated this child. Our contribution is a testable proposal, supported by working tools that others can use.
bullets: Question: can functional BubR1 be restored?
Status: proposed experiment; no drug rescue yet

title: Measure the variant before choosing its remedy
subtitle: Protein amount and protein function are different questions
label: 02 / THE MECHANISM
narration: The two identified variants affect the gene that makes Bub R one, a protein involved in chromosome separation. Their phase is inferred. The exact protein consequences remain unmeasured. The missense variant could reduce abundance, impair function, do both, or remain indeterminate. The proposed experiment compares full-length normal and altered protein at matched abundance. An isolated fragment's melting curve cannot settle that question.
bullets: Full-length WT and N1002K, abundance matched

title: Four experimental gates
subtitle: Variant effect, measurement, function and interpretation
label: 03 / THE EXPERIMENT
narration: The protocol has four gates. Gate A establishes the variant's effect using full-length protein at matched abundance. Gate B qualifies measurement, pathway response and exposure. Gate C measures chromosome segregation while separately tracking division and cell fate. Gate D applies prespecified confidence bounds. More protein alone cannot pass. Neither can apparent improvement from stopping division or selectively losing abnormal cells. Failed controls are indeterminate. An interval touching the worthwhile-benefit threshold is inconclusive. Only an interval entirely below that threshold rules out the programme's worthwhile benefit at that exposure. These are proposed research rules, not clinical thresholds.
bullets: C: measure function and cell fate
source: Functional rescue plan, gates A-D / proposed experiments

title: Gene-to-condition navigator
subtitle: Source roles remain visible
label: 04 / THE REUSABLE TOOL
narration: The offline navigator links genes to candidate conditions and shows each source's association role. Twenty-eight selected queries passed, with complete review of every returned source association: forty-seven gene and register-row pairs. This was a developer evaluation using the same source snapshots, not independent clinical validation. All register rows remain visible, including unmapped entries. A match does not establish eligibility. Queries stay on the device.
source: Expanded frozen query audit / HFEA register 2026-08-05

title: Rules that reject misleading hits
subtitle: Executable research decision prototype
label: 05 / THE RIGOR
narration: We implemented these rescue-decision rules as a research software prototype. All forty frozen synthetic cases matched their expected decisions, including protein-only signals, selective killing, missing data and confidence-boundary cases. This verifies software behaviour, not biological rescue. Separately, real Splice A I inference passes six controls. Its checker rejects nine injected failures. Laboratory function, exposure and independent replication remain unmeasured.
bullets: 40 frozen synthetic cases matched expected decisions
6 real SpliceAI controls; 9 checker faults rejected
source: Rescue-decision validation / SpliceAI measured controls and checker

title: The next result is clear
subtitle: Does N1002K retain function that this candidate can rescue?
label: 06 / THE NEXT STEP
narration: The next step is a laboratory test of full-length variant function and exposure-limited rescue. The proposal says what would advance the candidate and what would stop it. The reusable tools, source trail and plain-language explanation are delivered now. Clinical benefit remains to be earned. That is the standard we want this work judged against.
bullets: Delivered: code, source trail, protocol, communication
Next: independent functional and exposure validation
No claim of a proven treatment
